title: Slow dance in the kitchen
description: Dim the lights, put on a favorite song, and dance together with nowhere to be.

title: Handwritten note trail
description: Leave a path of short notes leading to a planned evening just for the two of you.

title: Sunrise coffee in bed
description: Wake early, bring coffee (or tea), and stay under the covers talking until you're ready.

title: Memory lane walk
description: Revisit a place that mattered early in your relationship and recreate a small moment.

title: Dress-code dare
description: One partner picks the outfit for the night out — playful, flattering, and a little daring.

title: Phone flirt all day
description: Send teasing messages throughout the day that build anticipation for the evening.

title: Blindfold taste test
description: Blindfold optional. Feed each other something sweet and savor the moment slowly.

title: Shower surprise
description: Join for a warm shower with soft lighting, music, and no rush.

title: Alias for a night
description: Invent new names and stay in character until you both agree to drop the act.

title: Yes / No / Try list
description: Share three yeses, three maybes, and one hard no — then pick one maybe to explore safely.

title: Control switch
description: Agree on a safe word. One leads for a set window of time; then switch if you both want.

title: Sensory playlist
description: Build a short sensory scene: sound, temperature, touch — keep it consensual and paced.

title: Picnic at home
description: Blanket on the floor, favorite snacks, candles, and phones away for an hour.

title: Compliment hour
description: Take turns saying what you genuinely admire — keep going until it feels a little vulnerable.

title: Bath drawn for you
description: Prepare a bath with music and a drink nearby. Sit close and talk, or sit in quiet.

title: First-date redo
description: Plan a night as if you're meeting again — dress up, ask curious questions, walk them to the door.

title: Mirror moment
description: Get ready together in front of a mirror — eye contact, teasing, and unhurried attention.

title: Stolen hallway kiss
description: Catch each other between chores for a lingering kiss that isn't rushed.

title: Massage with intent
description: A full back-and-shoulders massage that can stay sweet — or escalate if you both want.

title: Late-night kitchen raid
description: Midnight snack together, then linger in the kitchen longer than necessary.

title: Rules for the evening
description: Write three playful rules for the night. Keep consent clear and check in often.

title: Temperature play light
description: Ice cube or warm cloth — keep it gentle, verbal, and easy to stop.

title: Voice-only tease
description: Lights low. Use only words for a set time before any touch.

title: Restraint-lite
description: Soft scarf or holding wrists — agreed duration, safe word, and aftercare.
